articles.title: Scotland Captain Criticizes Team After Defeat
articles.summary: Scotland captain Andy Robertson expressed deep frustration after his side suffered a heavy 4-0 defeat against Switzerland in the Nations League. The loss cemented a disappointing third-place finish in their group, leaving Robertson to admit that the team simply does not have the necessary time to easily turn their poor form and current struggles around.

articles.title: Thomas Frank Appointed Crystal Palace Manager
articles.summary: Thomas Frank has been officially confirmed as the new manager of Crystal Palace following his departure from Tottenham earlier in the year. Tasked with improving the club's fortunes at Selhurst Park, Frank will look to rebuild his managerial reputation after a difficult previous spell in North London while aiming to steer the struggling squad away from trouble.

articles.title: Germany Rout Netherlands in Nations League
articles.summary: Germany delivered a dominant 5-0 victory against the Netherlands in Berlin, securing their place in the Nations League quarter-finals as group winners. Florian Wirtz scored twice, while Brajan Gruda, Derry Scherhant, and Nico Schlotterbeck also found the back of the net to cap off an impressive tactical performance under the leadership of manager Jürgen Klopp.

articles.title: Swansea Braced to Lose Vitor Matos
articles.summary: Swansea City are facing the departure of head coach Vitor Matos, who has indicated a strong desire to join French Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Strasbourg, which shares ownership ties with Chelsea, has targeted Matos to succeed Hugo Oliveira. Swansea are expected to receive appropriate financial compensation once the managerial transition is successfully finalized.

articles.title: Crystal Palace Name Thomas Frank Manager
articles.summary: Crystal Palace have appointed Thomas Frank on a two-and-a-half-year contract following the sacking of Pierre Sage. Having been out of work since leaving Tottenham in February, Frank was quickly targeted as the ideal candidate to take over at the Premier League side, with promises of financial backing for new signings during the upcoming January transfer window.

articles.title: Declan Rice Agrees New Arsenal Contract
articles.summary: Midfielder Declan Rice has verbally agreed to terms on a new, long-term contract with Arsenal. The agreement reflects the club's high valuation of his performances and importance to the squad since his high-profile arrival, securing his long-term future in North London as one of the team's key foundational players under Mikel Arteta.
